F-Zero X.name: F-Zero X
F-Zero X.summary: It's you against 29 other machines competing for the title of F-Zero X Champion. You're racing at speeds of over 1,000 km/h high above the atmosphere. Your competition comes from every corner of the galaxy and won't shed a tear at the thought of smashing you off the track. With four-player simultaneous gameplay and the Rumble Pak accessory, you have the fastest racing game on the N64 system!

Jet Force Gemini.name: Jet Force Gemini
Jet Force Gemini.summary:
The insect invasion has begun.

The galaxy is being infested by the evil Mizar and his horde of Drones. Already, the planet of Goldwood has been subjugated and the peaceful Tribals enslaved. With an arsenal of mega-weapons at their disposal, the Jet Force Gemini team must travel in search of Mizar's lair - rescuing Tribals and splattering Drones along the way. But can Juno, Vela and their faithful dog, Lupus, exterminate the deadly threat before it's too late?

Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu 6.name: Jikkyou Pawafuru Puroyakyu 6
Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu 6.summary: Jikkyou Pawafuru Puroyakyu 6 is the sixth mainline entry in the series. This entry introduces Dramatic Pennant, an updated Pennant Mode in which players can conduct training sessions throughout the season to enhance their team's abilities. Success Mode now takes place on a college baseball team, with 6 different colleges to pick from.

Shin Nihon Pro Wrestling Toukon Road - B.name: Shin Nippon Pro Wrestling: Toukon Road - Brave Spirits
Shin Nihon Pro Wrestling Toukon Road - B.summary: Shin Nippon Pro Wrestling: Toukon Road - Brave Spirits is a professional wrestling game released in 1997 for the PlayStation. It features wrestlers from New Japan Pro-Wrestling and focuses on simulation-style matches with a range of moves and techniques. The game includes multiple modes, including tournament and exhibition matches.

Supercross 2000.name: Supercross 2000
Supercross 2000.summary: EA SPORTS introduces the exclusive game of the Supercross Series. There are 24 riders, 16 real stadiums, 21 real tracks, and 3 freestyle courses bring the Supercross to life. Race for the checkers in a Quick Race then compete for the Championship- or fly with style in freestyle mode. Bar-to-Bar competition, big air, sick tricks, 2-player mode, and real Supercross series make EA SPORTS Supercross 2000 the game to beat!
